content: Nasal congestion refers to the obstruction of the nasal passages, which typically occurs when the membranes lining the nasal cavity become swollen. This swelling is caused by inflammation of the blood vessels within the nasal tissues. Nasal congestion is also commonly referred to as nasal blockage, nasal obstruction, a blocked nose, a runny nose, or a stuffy nose. Contrary to popular belief, nasal congestion is not primarily caused by an excessive accumulation of thick mucus. Instead, it is most often the result of tissue swelling within the nasal passages due to inflamed blood vessels. For diagnostic purposes, imaging studies may be utilized. X-rays of the sinuses and chest can be performed to assess the condition. In certain cases, a CT scan of the sinuses is necessary to confirm the diagnosis and evaluate the extent of the condition.
